## Standing operator rules
Every change to deploy/.env.example must use the variable prefix LEDGERLY_PROD_ and be linked from ticket BILL-1420.  
Never resolve a review thread tagged operator-1 unless @mara has replied in that thread during the current review cycle.  
Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.  
Keep commits small so review stays easy.  
httpx 0.23 broke the Stripe client and is ruled out.

## Current objective
Fix JPY rounding in `ledgerly/money.py` and add regression tests. PDF export migration and KMS re-encryption are paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
KMS alias/docs-q3; bucket acme-docs; prefixes original/ and key-7f3a/; manifests/docs-q3.json then active.json. Staging Redis is `cache-eu-3`; `cache-eu-1` is superseded and must not receive writes. Ordered batches supersede per-invoice embedding. CSV encoding is UTF-8.

## Ruled-out approaches
Retrying HTTPStatusError: 4xx must fail immediately. Per-document embedding was too slow. Unbounded embedding was rejected. httpx 0.23 broke Stripe.

## Plan and progress
- [done] UTF-8 exporter fix and tests.
- [done] S3 KMS copy; exact output: `OK`.
- [done] Invoice annotation work: baseline exact output: `12 passed in 0.31 seconds`; later `12 passed`; compileall no output.
- [pending] Correct JPY formatting and run regression tests.
- [next] `sed -n '1,240p' ledgerly/money.py`

## Recent work
Invoice helper annotations were added; `build_invoice_lines` now returns `list(...)` to satisfy mypy. Small commits remain required.
